article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Michael Zanoni and Ethan Lin scored 20 points each as Pennsylvania beat La Salle 83-73 on Saturday. Zanoni shot 5 for 14 (2 for 7 from 3-point range) and 8 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Quakers (3-3). Lin shot 6 for 10 (5 for 7 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line. T.J. Power shot 5 for 15 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points, while adding 12 rebounds and six assists. Noah Collier led the Explorers (2-4) in scoring, finishing with 13 points and two blocks. Trey Moss added 13 points for La Salle. Kam Burton finished with 11 points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
